performance.verdict: Meta went dark Sep 16 — every paid channel is offline; scoreboard untrustworthy.

findings.text: Meta channel_dark confirmed: spend dropped to $0 on Sep 16 and has stayed at $0 for 9 consecutive days, killing all 49 leads sourced this month.

5 overdue SOW milestones dating back to 2026-07-23 — phone attribution gap, sync cleanup, dashboard, and both renewal scoreboard items — remain undelivered. August prove-it month has passed with 0 new patients confirmed in GHL.

GHL shows 56 opps created from 322 contacts, 0 won, 0 appointments, $895.86 pipeline value — against 49 Windsor-reported leads. 7-lead gap and 0 booked appointments signals intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions collapsed -64% (7d), from a period averaging ~10/day to near-zero. IG reach is down -98% to effectively 0. Both organic signals confirm the dark period is not isolated to paid.
3-day signal (Sep 21–23): spend $0/$0/$0, leads 0/0/0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 18–20): spend $38.94/$18.49/$0, leads 0/0/0. Paid was already dying before the full blackout on Sep 16.

suggestions.text: Reactivate Meta immediately — identify why account went dark Sep 16 and restore spend to prior ~$25/day baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend dropped to $0 on September 16 and has not recovered across 9 days, eliminating all lead flow (prior rate: ~3 leads/day at $9.87 CPL). Investigate billing hold, ad disapproval, or account suspension and restore to the prior ~$25/day run rate. Success check: Meta spend resumes and at least 2 leads register within 3 days of reactivation. Re-check by 2026-09-27.

suggestions.text: Close the GHL intake leak: reconcile 56 opps vs 49 leads and surface why 0 appointments are booked against a $895.86 pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 56 opportunities created from 322 contacts with $895.86 pipeline value, yet 0 appointments are recorded — this means leads are entering but nothing is being scheduled. Audit the intake workflow: confirm Lily (or new hire) is actioning GHL leads, check that the contact-to-opportunity stage trigger is firing, and verify the appointment booking step is connected. Success check: at least 5 appointments logged in GHL within 7 days of the fix. Re-check by 2026-10-01.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery after Meta reactivation — GBP actions were -64% this week; confirm organic rebounds once paid traffic returns.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell -64% in the last 7 days alongside Meta going dark, suggesting paid traffic was boosting local profile engagement. After Meta is restored, monitor GBP actions returning toward the prior ~10/day average. No action needed now. Re-check by 2026-09-27 to confirm correlation or flag an independent GBP issue.
